rows.reason: rejectionReason is reached by a plain validation refusal, not only by an IO/store fault. It is called on the claim result at consultation.ts:198 and on the submit result at :476. A host caller can send an ordinary message to an idle recipient and then POST workflow/consultation with a structurally valid roleBinding whose templateId is not in the project role matrix: isolateInput accepts any RoleBindingRefV1 shape (consultation.ts:80-87), submitQueryJob does not resolve the role (query-job-service.ts:286-325), and claimQuery then returns rejected: resolveRoleBindingFacts returns ready with status inadmissible (role-memory-service.ts:704-708) and claimQuery maps it to rejectedWithNonEmptyCurrent('forbidden', ...) at query-execution.ts:943 (or the legacy mismatch at :954-957). The 'rejected' branch of rejectionReason therefore runs with no fault and no tampering. Codex's F needs an injected store failure; that is not necessary.

rows.reason: readFailure runs on a plain not_found, not only on an IO fault. A fresh sessions/archive-line request misses the receipt lookup (session-lifecycle.ts:1083-1086 returns archive_request_receipt_not_found), so archiveLine goes to first acceptance, calls readFacts (session-archive.ts:795-796), and readSessionFacts returns rejected/not_found for a missing Session (session-facts.ts:197-202 -> readSessionRecord :174-190). That rejection is passed to readFailure at session-archive.ts:183 and returned at :796; the status/not_found/incomplete branches at :108-112 execute. No store wrapper or injected fault is needed.

rows.reason: queryRunIsUnknown is called by any archive request whose execution is a Query with confirmUnknownStopped true (session-archive.ts:399-406), not only after a crash. A live claimed Query already gives that execution: queries/submit then queries/claim on Session S occupies S (query-execution.ts:894-895), and requestSessionArchive records execution {kind:'query', queryRunRef} for a QueryRun occupancy (session-lifecycle.ts:866-867, then :959-961). archiveLine first acceptance does not block a Query occupancy (session-archive.ts:803-811 only inspects a Run), so drive calls queryRunIsUnknown at :405-406; the claimed Query is listed and its phase is not 'unknown', so the function runs and returns false. Only the unknown=true attestation needs the restart; the function itself needs no fault.

rows.reason: The ordinary-input arm (session-maintenance.ts:356-360) needs a readonly_copy whose provenance message is neither inquiry nor needsReply and carries an acceptedInputs entry. The platform's own copy writer creates a copy only for an inquiry message (consultation.ts:364, 387-397). For a copy to receive an ordinary message and be the claimed recipient, the copy must exist before the message; docs/refactor/design/orchestration-2026-10/slices/slice-1-SPEC.md:180 requires the copy's message to exist at creation and to match consultationDerivation.childSessionRef or that creation's fixed derivation, which a caller-named copy of an arbitrary ordinary message cannot satisfy. That check is missing: session-directory.ts:710-712 only calls checkSessionProvenance, which validates the messageRef shape and project but not existence/derivation (session-record-codecs.ts:418-431). So today a host caller can still inject the shape (or hand-build a consultation intent whose recipient is the copy at query-execution.ts:902-913/925-928), but no platform-owned writer produces it. With the required check the state cannot arise.
rows.proposal: Add the slice-1 §2.2 creation check at session-directory.ts:710-712: for kind 'readonly_copy' the message must exist, and its consultationDerivation.childSessionRef (or the creation's fixed derivation) must be the planned Session. Then this ordinary-input arm cannot arise and session-maintenance.ts:356-360 can be deleted; keep the asksReply branch at :347-355, which is the real copy path. Do not add a test that builds a spec-invalid copy.

rows.reason: Same reachability as C3-062: the inner .some callback at session-maintenance.ts:359 runs only after an acceptedInputs entry with part='message' is found, which needs the same ordinary-input readonly_copy. No platform writer creates such a copy (consultation.ts:364, 387-397 writes copies only for inquiry messages), and docs/refactor/design/orchestration-2026-10/slices/slice-1-SPEC.md:180 requires the creation's message to exist and to match the fixed derivation, so a caller-named copy of an arbitrary ordinary message must be refused. That check is not implemented at session-directory.ts:710-712 (session-record-codecs.ts:418-431 checks only the messageRef shape), which is the only way the arm is reachable today.
rows.proposal: Same fix and deletion as C3-062: implement the §2.2 creation check at session-directory.ts:710-712, then delete the ordinary-input branch at session-maintenance.ts:356-360 (both the outer entry callback at :358 and the inner callback at :359) and keep the inquiry branch.
